inputs.usage: Hair-only edit; do not use A/repair-01.png.

prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve
Asset type: gameplay-sprite hair comparison candidate C
Input image: the supplied PNG is the sole edit target and the accepted provisional pixel-art baseline.
Primary request: Edit ONLY the character's hair. Convert the existing low nape ponytail into fully loose, long near-black hair swept back off the face and falling to the upper back. No tied section, no bun, and no ponytail. Preserve the same near-black hair color family, long-hair length family, existing exposed hairline, and fully visible face.
Style/medium: Maintain EXACTLY the source image's coarse uniform square pixel grid and its small 2D beat-em-up gameplay-sprite construction. Use only 4–6 simple broad graphic locks, large consistent square pixel steps, and broad flat shadow/highlight clusters. Absolutely no fine individual hair strands, painterly texture, realistic rendering, smoothing, or pixel-filter effect.
Composition/framing: Preserve the exact 1024x1536 portrait canvas, centered full body framing, standing pose, and visible feet.
Constraints: Change hair only. Preserve every other pixel-level design choice from the target: actual body proportions, stance, indigo/charcoal/steel/rust outfit, chest plate, bracer, sheathed sword, boots, face expression, skin, lighting, opaque light-neutral background, and canvas framing. Keep the existing base-image vignette exactly unchanged. Do not introduce alpha/transparency. Do not redraw or restyle any non-hair area.
Avoid: ponytail, tied hair, bun, fine strands, hair over the face, altered facial features, altered clothing, altered weapon, altered pose, altered background, new objects, text, UI, additional figures.
